title: kookr-evolution-trial.v1
description: Result of evaluating a single trial in an autonomous evolution run. This JSON is the ONLY interface between Kookr and a project's evaluation command: the project writes it, Kookr reads it. Kookr never parses the artifact under evolution. See docs/rfc/issue-1061-autonomous-evolution-playbook/RFC.md.

schemaVersion.description: Schema discriminator. Always the literal version string.

ok.description: true: the trial was evaluated and `score` is meaningful. false: evaluation failed (a FAILED trial, not a regression) — `score` is ignored and the trial counts toward the failure budget, not the plateau window.

score.description: The primary scalar the run optimizes. Required when `ok` is true. Direction is set by the run config's `higherIsBetter`.

higherIsBetter.description: Optional echo of the optimization direction for this score. The run config is the source of truth; if present here it MUST agree with the config.

metrics.description: Optional secondary metrics, passed through verbatim to the trial log and run summary. Kookr never interprets these beyond display.

artifactRef.description: Opaque pointer (relative path or id) to the trial's artifact. Kookr archives this on promotion but never parses it.

notes.description: Free-text rationale or observation about this trial, surfaced in the run summary.

evaluatedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the trial was evaluated.

allOf.$comment: A successfully evaluated trial MUST carry a numeric score. A missing score on ok:true is treated by the playbook as a FAILED trial.

examples.notes: widened the entry band; fewer whipsaws
backtest aborted: missing price data for 2024-03
